name: browser-workflow-profiles
goal: Profile one actual browser workflow and its settled renderer heap without borrowing a previous navigation or replaying the action

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: NavigationTiming correctly rejects soft destinations, leaving completed browser workflows without runtime profiles. The existing collector has no action boundary and never invokes a supplied workflow.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Extend the same seven-case page-workload protocol with execute-once, failed-action and evidence-off cases. Protocol numbers stay isolated and removed; actual app observations must come from the real browser workload.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed be16166f at 73d27fc79: old navigation capture never executes the workflow callback, including when evidence is off; failed-action control also exposes an incorrect success.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The Harness adapter measures one actual action with zero warmups or replays, then reads settled browser heap and build identity. It preserves execute-once behavior when evidence is off and records no success on rejection.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed unchanged ten-case corpus: 80e2169e red and a1e1b450 green at 13c45ac51. Prior navigation refusal and inspector cleanup cases remain passing.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
